title: Lowercase author search
statementMd:
Find authors whose name, ignoring case, contains `an`. Show the name in upper case.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT UPPER(name) AS name FROM authors WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%an%';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
